decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey side extension, as shown on drawing numbers 200/05 & 200/06, received 22 November 2006 is recommended for approval as it is considered that the extension, by reason of its size, materials, location and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 3 Beverley Road, Chiswick. The extension would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) policies ENV-1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east facing walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to the existing house.
